pages.title: 50 years of the Emergency — Cabinet resolution

facts.text: 25 June 2025: Union Cabinet resolution honouring resistance to the Emergency; day called 'Samvidhan Hatya Diwas'
facts.head: News

facts.text: Emergency: declared 25 June 1975 by PM Indira Gandhi on "internal disturbance" under Article 352; lasted 21 months till 21 March 1977
facts.head: News

facts.text: ⚠ Article 352, not 356
facts.head: News

facts.text: Type: National Emergency; Article: 352 — war, external aggression, armed rebellion
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Type: President's Rule; Article: 356 (with 365)
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Type: Financial Emergency; Article: 360
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Emergency provisions: Articles 352–360
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Features: Article 19 rights suspended; press censorship; arrests under MISA; ADM Jabalpur v. Shivkant Shukla (habeas corpus suspended); forced sterilisation
facts.head: Background

facts.text: 42nd Amendment (1976): "Mini-Constitution" — added Socialist, Secular to Preamble; DPSPs over FRs; curbed judiciary
facts.head: Background

facts.text: 44th Amendment (1978): Janata govt — reversed many changes; "internal disturbance" → "armed rebellion"
facts.head: Background

facts.text: ECINET: Election Commission Integrated Network — announced 4 May 2025; integrates 40+ ECI apps
facts.head: News

facts.text: First used: bypolls of 19 June 2025 in Kerala, Gujarat, Punjab, West Bengal; results 23 June
facts.head: News

facts.text: Turnout upload: directly by presiding officers (⚠ not returning officers) before leaving polling station
facts.head: News

facts.text: Index Cards: non-statutory constituency-level statistical reports — auto-filled, published within 72 hours
facts.head: News

facts.text: Released by: Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD) — draft for public comments
facts.head: News

facts.text: Replaces: Registration Act, 1908 (117 years old)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Why: land/property disputes are over two-thirds of civil cases
facts.head: News

facts.text: Section: Sec 29; Provision: end-to-end digital + offline registration; Aadhaar or offline ID; 29(4) — no denial for lack of Aadhaar
facts.head: Key provisions

facts.text: Section: Sec 12; Provision: compulsory registration expanded — agreement of sale, power of attorney, mortgage by deposit of title deeds, corporate mergers/demergers (Companies Act 2013)
facts.head: Key provisions

facts.text: Section: Sec 13; Provision: "optional registration" — undefined
facts.head: Key provisions

facts.text: Section: Sec 4(5); Provision: new Additional/Assistant Inspector Generals of Registration
facts.head: Key provisions

facts.text: Section: Sec 58, 64; Provision: refusal (e.g. delay over four months, wills exempt); 64(3) — Inspector General can cancel fraudulent registration; appeal in 30 days
facts.head: Key provisions

facts.text: Section: Penalty; Provision: jail cut from 7 years to 3 years
facts.head: Key provisions

facts.text: ⚠ Aadhaar is not mandatory; penalty is reduced, not increased
facts.head: Key provisions

facts.text: Concern: delegation to Common Service Centres (CSCs)
facts.head: Key provisions
